# UI Contract: Projection Page Periodicity Control

## Component ids (generated by `src/components/periodicity_controls.py`, prefix `projection`)

| Id | Component |
|----|-----------|
| `projection-parameters-periodicity-{day,week,month,quarter,year}` | Interval buttons (`n_clicks`, `active`, `outline`, `disabled`) |
| `projection-parameters-periodicity-group` | Button group |
| `projection-parameters-periodicity-label` | Label, text "Periodicity" |
| `projection-periodicity-store` | `dcc.Store`, `{value, explicit}` (see data-model.md) |

Placement in the parameters bar: after the "Project to" calendar picker, before the date
validation message.

## Callbacks

1. **`_apply_periodicity_click`** — Inputs: the five buttons' `n_clicks`, `projection-mount-trigger.max_intervals`;
   Output: store `data` (`allow_duplicate`). Ignores the mount-time fire. Writes `{value, explicit: true}`.
2. **`_derive_periodicity`** — Inputs: `projection-target-store.data`, `app-parameters-account.value`,
   `projection-accounts-store.data`, mount trigger; State: store `data`; Output: store `data`
   (`allow_duplicate`). No target/account/data → `PreventUpdate`. Explicit → rewrite unchanged.
   Otherwise write `{value: derived, explicit: false}`. Never sets `explicit: true`.
3. **`_style_periodicity_buttons`** — Input: store `data`; Outputs: each button's `active` and `outline`.
4. **`_render_chart`** (changed) — Inputs: account, start date, store `data`, return toggles; States:
   target store, toggle ids, accounts store; `running` disables the five buttons. Passes
   `store.value` as `periodicity`. Empty/error states unchanged.

## Service call

`get_projection(account_name, projection_date, returns, start, periodicity=<store.value>)` —
unchanged signature; `periodicity` now comes from the store rather than an inline derivation.

## Behavioural guarantees

- Exactly one `get_projection` call per target change, horizon click, calendar pick or interval click.
- With `explicit: false` the interval equals the one produced before this feature for the same inputs.
- The highlighted button always equals the interval passed to the service.
